outcome: neonatal asphyxia at the fifth minute of life
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 1803 singleton deliveries from two health facilities in the Oku sub-division, Cameroon, between 2009 and 2016, excluding records without maternal age, babies born before arrival, birthweights less than 1000g, multiple deliveries, and deliveries before 28 weeks gestation.
finding: Adolescent deliveries accounted for 20.4% of all deliveries and were significantly associated with second-fourth degree perineal tears, low birthweight, and neonatal asphyxia at the fifth minute of life, with a significant downward trend in adolescent deliveries and neonatal asphyxia observed from 2009 to 2016.
